jobs.description:
Join a hands-on IT team where networking isn’t just about maintaining infrastructure : it’s about building, securing and continuously improving it.

We are looking for aNetwork Engineerto join a collaborative and hands-on team, working closely with internal IT specialists and external partners.

 

What makes this role different?You’ll be close to the technology.You’ll actively work on the infrastructure, troubleshoot real-world challenges and contribute to network and security projects rather than simply managing tickets from the sidelines.
Network Engineer - What's the job about
• Network Infrastructure:Design, configure and maintain enterprise network environments, with a strong focus onFortinet & Palo Altotechnologies.
• Network Security:Managefirewalls, VPNs, IDS/IPS and security policies, ensuring a secure and reliable infrastructure.
• Hands-on Troubleshooting:Investigate complex network issues, identify root causes and implement effective solutions using tools such asWireshark, PRTG or SolarWinds.
• Projects & Improvements:Contribute tonetwork upgrades, segmentation, SD-WAN and security projects, from implementation through to optimisation.
• Collaboration:Work closely withIT teams, vendors and service providersto integrate and improve network solutions.
• Documentation:Keep network configurations, diagrams, procedures and technical documentation accurate and up to date.
Network Engineer - Who we are looking for
• 4+ years of experiencein network administration or network engineering, ideally in a complex IT environment.
• Strong hands-on expertise withFortinetsolutions, including FortiGate, FortiManager, FortiAnalyzer and VPNs.
• Solid experience withPalo Alto, particularly firewalls, Panorama and GlobalProtect.
• Strong understanding ofTCP/IP, VLANs, routing, OSPF/BGP, DNS, DHCP and network segmentation.
• A genuineproblem-solverwho enjoys troubleshooting, getting into the technical details and finding practical solutions.
• Fluent in English and French, with good communication skills and the ability to work effectively within a team.

Bedrijfsomschrijving 

Our client is an established family-owned company with more than 30 years of experience in the food industry, specialized in the production and processing of fresh potato products.

The company combines modern production technology with a strong focus on quality, hygiene and food safety. You will join a professional and dynamic production environment where teamwork, reliability and quality are key.

We are currently looking for an experienced and motivated Line Supervisor to join a production environment in the food industry. You will be responsible for the smooth operation of the production line and will help ensure that production runs safely, efficiently, and according to quality standards.

• 
Forklift experience

 
• 
Willingness to work in the food production industry

• 
Very good command of English

jobs.occupation: Product Owner – Employee Benefits & Group Insurance
jobs.description:
Responsibilities

• Define and communicate the product vision, roadmap, and priorities for key Employee Benefits processes.
• Translate business requirements and customer feedback into clear features, epics, and user stories.
• Manage and prioritize the product backlog to maximize business value and customer impact.

• Implement sophisticated deployment strategies such as blue/green deployment.
• Configure and optimize cloud resources within the Microsoft Azure ecosystem.
• Collaborate within a cross-functional team to deliver reliable transport operations solutions.

• You possess 8+ years of professional experience in backend development using .NET Core, .NET 8, and REST API.
• You have 5+ years of hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure in a professional context.
• You bring 5+ years of experience in DevOps practices including CI/CD pipelines, YAML, and blue/green deployment.

Responsibilities

• Maintain contact with various team leaders to align planning and report progress to management.

• Conduct risk analysis on project plans and proactively propose mitigation strategies or alternatives.
• Communicate technical changes and project updates clearly to diverse stakeholders.
• Coach team members in project follow-up and ensure high-quality documentation.
• Facilitate the integration of traditional project management standards with Agile methodologies across different teams.

Requirements

• 10+ years of experience in project management across multiple domains.
• 5+ years of specialized experience managing Cybersecurity projects.
• Experience leading and coordinating projects involving at least 5 different teams.
• Proven knowledge of project management standards such as PMBOK, Prince2, or RUP.
• Practical experience with Agile methodologies including Scrum, Kanban, or Lean.
• Experience with Compliance reporting and ticketing systems like JIRA.
• High-level understanding of secure configurations for Networking, Servers, Windows, Linux, and Android.
• Knowledge of IT security frameworks such as NIST CSF, ISO 27001, NIS2, GDPR, or DORA.
• Strong communication skills and a result-oriented, proactive mindset.
• You are fluent in Dutch or French with a solid knowledge of the other language and English.

• Basic knowledge of security concepts such as Zero Trust, SIEM, SOAR, PKI, DevSecOps, IAM, and PAM.
• Experience with security monitoring and response tools.
• Willingness to obtain a Top Secret security clearance.

Proximus Global, combining the strengths of Telesign, BICS, and Route Mobile, is shaping the future of communications and digital identity.

Our mission is simple : to enable seamless global connectivity and trusted engagements that power the world's interactions.

Together, our solutions fuel innovation across the world's largest companies and emerging brands. With a truly global reach, we enable businesses to create engaging customer experiences while integrating fraud protection across the entire lifecycle.

Our portfolio covers global voice, messaging and data connectivity, alongside 5G and IoT solutions. It also includes digital identity, verification and CPaaS platforms for personalised, omnichannel engagement. Through these capabilities, we help businesses and communities stay connected, secure and ready to grow. Today, we reach more than 5 billion subscribers, secure over 180 billion transactions every year, and connect more than 1,000 destinations worldwide — delivering on our commitment to connect, protect and engage everywhere.
Key highlights
Powering more than 13 billion digital communications every month

Supporting over 3,500 active customers through a presence in 50+ global offices across 100+ countries

Managing 50% of global roaming data traffic and connecting 150 million IoT devices

Driving innovation in 5G, private networks and IoT, reinforcing our position in next-generation communications

 

Please note that this position is open on a permanent contract (no freelance) and is based in Brussels with an on-site presence required 2 to 3 days a week. Applicants must have the legal right to work in Belgium.

Join a highly skilled engineering team driving the evolution of global roaming and data core services. In this role, you'll take ownership of technical solutions from design to delivery, helping shape the next generation of connectivity services.

Responsabilities:

•  Lead the analysis, architecture, design and implementation of network platforms and OSS solutions supporting service fulfilment, provisioning, assurance and automation.
• Own technical projects end-to-end, from requirements gathering and solution design through testing, integration and production deployment.
• Evaluate network and OSS technologies, define target architectures and recommend platform evolutions based on business, operational and regulatory requirements.
• Collaborate with Product, Operations, IT and Engineering teams to deliver scalable, reliable and secure network solutions.
• Support vendor selection, RFI/RFP processes and technical assessments of third-party solutions.
• Produce technical designs, architecture documentation, impact assessments and implementation guidelines.
• Drive proof of concepts, technical trials and platform roadmap activities to validate new capabilities and technologies.
• Act as the technical authority for the assigned domain, providing expert guidance to internal stakeholders, partners and suppliers.
 

Technical Requirements

• Degree in Telecommunications, Computer Science, IT, or a related field.
• At least 6 years of experience in the telecommunications or IT industry.
• Strong knowledge of telecommunications networks, mobile core technologies and international roaming services.
• Hands-on expertise in mobile packet core technologies (4G/5G), including components such as SMF, UPF, PGW, SGW and roaming interfaces like S8 and N4.
• Solid understanding of roaming architectures and services, including VoLTE, IMS, Home Routing, Local Breakout (LBO) and roaming hub solutions.
• Knowledge of signalling and telecom protocols such as Diameter, SS7 and SCTP.
• Experience configuring, operating and troubleshooting telecom platforms, including monitoring and testing tools such as Splunk and SIGOS.
• Familiarity with Linux environments, scripting and automation (Bash, Python or similar).
• Exposure to cloud, containerisation and DevOps technologies (Kubernetes, OpenShift, AWS, CI/CD) is a plus.
• Experience in the international carrier or wholesale telecommunications industry is an advantage.
• Excellent written and spoken English.
Soft Skills 

• Strong analytical and solution‑oriented mindset, with the ability to approach challenges creatively and efficiently. 
• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, enabling smooth collaboration across multidisciplinary teams. 
• Solid coordination and planning capabilities, with flexibility to adapt to changing situations and unexpected issues. 
• Proactive attitude, strong sense of ownership, and willingness to learn fast and go the extra mile when needed. 
• Well‑organized, resilient under pressure, and able to manage risks effectively with quick and sound decision‑making. 
• Result‑oriented, customer‑focused and committed to delivering high‑quality outcomes.

Responsibilities

• Analyze complex databases to gain relevant insights using advanced manipulation and visualization tools.
• Develop consistent and accurate datasets for new and existing periodic reports.
• Improve and automate data analysis and reporting processes by initiating change management.
• Identify and implement optimization opportunities to rationalize the existing reporting portfolio.
• Support stakeholders with self-service reporting tools to foster a culture of data autonomy.
• Document and analyze reporting requirements to propose and implement suitable data solutions.

Requirements

• 5+ years of experience in data analysis and reporting within a complex environment.
• 5+ years of experience in dataset development and the creation of reporting solutions.
• 5+ years of experience in process improvement, reporting automation, and portfolio optimization.
• You possess advanced skills in Python, SQL, and SAS for database querying and optimization.
• You have professional experience with Databricks and Power BI for data analysis and visualization.
• You bring proficiency in MS Office 365 for business reporting tasks.
• You have an analytical mindset and the ability to drive and support change initiatives.
• You are proactive, solution-oriented, and possess strong communication and collaborative skills.
• You are fluent in English with a fluent level of Dutch or French and a good level of the other.
Nice to Haves

• Experience in the insurance or financial services industry.
• Experience with Azure and Microsoft Fabric.
• Knowledge of data modeling techniques.
• Experience with end-to-end requirements management including elicitation and validation.

Responsibilities

• Translate high-level architecture and domain models into detailed analysis documents, user stories, and technical specifications.
• Apply Domain-Driven Design principles to define bounded contexts, aggregate roots, entities, and repositories.
• Collaborate with legacy system experts to identify refactoring requirements and support seamless system integration.
• Design and implement modern .NET components and APIs aligned with predefined architectural contracts.
• Support the adoption of domain-driven thinking within the team through technical analysis and coaching.
• Deliver end-to-end features including integration testing and deployment while maintaining high code quality standards.

Requirements

• You have 3+ years of backend development experience with .NET.
• You possess 3+ years of experience in technical analysis and translating architecture into actionable technical requirements.
• You bring practical experience with Domain-Driven Design (DDD) and Service Oriented Architecture (SOA).
• You have experience in API implementation and basic knowledge of Event-driven architectures.
• You possess a proactive mindset regarding legacy system integration and COBOL impact analysis.
• You're communicative, coaching-oriented, and comfortable managing complexity and ambiguity.

• Experience working within Scrum or Agile environments.
• Previous exposure to large-scale, complex .NET projects.
• Knowledge of AI-augmented delivery tools.
• Experience coaching teams on DDD methodologies.

jobs.description:

This role is a HR Officer Learning & Development position focused on coordinating training, performance management, and job structuring processes while ensuring strong adoption of HR tools across the organization.
It is ideal for a dynamic and structured profile who enjoys working with people, coordinating trainings, and driving change in a digital HR environment. 

Client Details

Our client is an international company combining a corporate, international culture with a strong focus on efficiency, quality, and innovation. They support business operations through technology-driven solutions and continuous improvement of internal processes.

The environment is collaborative and evolving, offering employees the opportunity to grow and develop within the company. The company is located in Diegem at the border with Brussels and is easily accessible with public transport.

Description

As L&D HR Officer, you'll be responsible for:

• Coordinate, organize, and deliver training sessions
• Maintain & update the training catalogue
• Identify development needs and manage relationships with external training providers
• Ensure accurate HR data management and documentation (training records, performance data, job files)
• Coordinate and manage the performance management cycle (ensuring timely completion of objectives setting and reviews)
• Act as key user of HR tools providing user support and driving adoption across the organization
• Maintain and update job descriptions, job grading, and organizational charts
• Support career development initiatives
• Contribute and support HR activities when needed

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in HR, training, education, or a related field
• Fluent in English, with a good command of French and Dutch
• First experience in HR, HR Development, Learning & Development, or a similar role (junior profiles welcome)
• Dynamic, proactive, and able to convince stakeholders to adopt new tools and processes
• Strong organizational skills with a structured and detail-oriented mindset
• Curious and hands-on, with a willingness to learn and take ownership of HR systems and tools
• Strong communication skills with the ability to interact at all levels of the organization

The company is an international player in the chemical industry, focused on producing basic raw materials derived from oil and gas. These materials are used by other companies to manufacture products such as packaging, plastic components, industrial applications, and consumer goods.

Operating on a global scale, the organization combines manufacturing, logistics, and international trade within a highly integrated business model. The work environment is strongly process-driven, with a focus on quality, supply chain excellence, and customer satisfaction.

In addition, the company places a strong emphasis on innovation and sustainability, investing in more efficient production processes and the development of increasingly recyclable materials.

Jobomschrijving

Job Description

In this role, you will play a central part in processing and managing customer orders within an international environment. You will ensure smooth administrative handling while monitoring quality, timelines, and communication throughout the entire order lifecycle.

Key Responsibilities
	
• Coordinate and manage the complete order process from request to delivery	
• Process sales orders and quotations with a strong focus on accuracy	
• Liaise with internal departments regarding product availability, deliveries, and invoicing	
• Prepare and manage export documentation for international shipments	
• Handle returns and follow up on customer complaints	
• Keep customers informed about order status and deliveries through reporting tools	
• Maintain proactive communication with stakeholders, including customers, Sales, Supply Chain, and Finance teams	
• Prepare and distribute reports on order status, deliveries, and critical issues	
• Identify potential bottlenecks within processes and contribute to improvement initiatives	
• Participate in internal meetings and collaborate with various departments

Requirements
	
• Bachelor's degree or equivalent through experience	
• 1 to 3 years of experience in customer service, administration, or order management	
• Experience in an international environment is a strong asset	
• Experience in the shipping industry	
• Experience with shipping documents (Sea Waybill, Bill of Lading,...)	
• Good knowledge of Microsoft Office applications (Excel, Teams, Power BI)	
• Knowledge of Incoterms and international payment terms is considered an advantage	
• Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously	
• Highly detail-oriented with a strong focus on quality and accuracy	
• Proactive and solution-oriented mindset	
• Customer-focused with excellent communication skills	
• Team player who thrives in an open and collaborative working environment	
• Able to work independently with a hands-on approach	
• Fluent in English, both written and spoken. Knowledge of Italian, Spanish, or any other additional language is a plus.

For a family-run company in the tyre sector, we are looking for an experienced tyre fitter to join the branch in Destelbergen.

Our client works for cars, trucks, agriculture and industry, and runs several branches across Belgium.

Hoe ziet jouw takenpakket eruit?
 
• You fit, repair and balance tyres. Plenty of trucks and agricultural vehicles, so proper work with heavy equipment. 
• You work cleanly and safely. A wheel that is not perfectly secured is never an option. 
• You step in wherever you are needed. In a small team, everyone pitches in. 
• After six months to a year, once you know the job inside out, you also join roadside call-outs. The employer pays for the training and your category C licence.
 
• Experience as a tyre fitter. By far the most important point on this list. 
• A category B driving licence. 
• Dutch or English is enough. If French is your main language, we do need a basic level of English on top of it so you can work smoothly with the team. No need to be fluent. 
• Someone who is punctual, gets stuck in and takes safety seriously. 
• The ambition to build something long term with one employer.
